h1: Christmas Decorating for Office Lobbies and Corporate Buildings
heroIntro: Give tenants, employees, and visiting clients a lobby that feels considered, not last-minute. We design, install, maintain, and remove your holiday décor on your building's schedule, fully insured.
intro: Office towers and corporate campuses across London, Kitchener-Waterloo, Hamilton, and the western GTA come to us for one reason: a lobby display has to look sharp for the whole season without anyone on the property staff climbing a ladder or chasing down a burned-out strand. We design lobby and atrium décor that fits the scale of the space, from a single-tenant head office to a multi-floor commercial tower, and we handle every part of it ourselves, from the first sketch to the January pickup.

Facilities managers usually oversee more than one building, so we build our process around that reality. A single point of contact, one proposal covering every property in your portfolio, and installation scheduled after tenants have gone home for the day. We supply commercial-grade lighting and greenery, mount everything without damaging finishes or ceiling tiles, and check in mid-season so nothing looks tired by the time the office holiday party rolls around in December.

whyItPays.heading: The First Thing Every Visitor Notices
whyItPays.text: A lobby is the first physical space a client, candidate, or new tenant experiences inside your building. A clean, well-lit holiday display signals that the property is well managed year-round, not just decorated once and forgotten. Employees notice too, and a warm lobby during the darkest weeks of the year is a small, low-cost boost to morale that outlasts the season itself.

whyItPays.heading: Insured Work at Height, After Hours
whyItPays.text: We carry full insurance and run WSIB-compliant crews, and installs happen after tenants have left the building so there is zero disruption to daytime operations. No property staff is ever asked to climb a ladder, wire an outlet, or troubleshoot a flickering strand. If anything needs attention mid-season, our crew handles it directly, not your maintenance team, and not a tenant who happens to notice a bulb has gone dark.

whyItPays.heading: One Invoice Across Your Whole Portfolio
whyItPays.text: Facilities managers juggling several buildings get a single proposal, a single install schedule, and one invoice instead of coordinating separate vendors per property. Sign on for a multi-year program and pricing stays predictable while we store your lobby décor between seasons, so nothing takes up space in a maintenance closet, a loading dock, or a tenant storage locker all year round.

process: Send photos or building plans, or book a site visit so we can measure lobby height, ceiling clearance, and power access
We send a design proposal and quote covering trees, garland, and entrance lighting, sized to your space and budget
Installation is scheduled after hours or on a weekend so tenants and staff see zero disruption during business days
We check in mid-season, then remove and store everything in January so the lobby is back to normal for the new year

faq.q: Can you work around building security and after-hours access requirements?
faq.a: Yes. Most office towers need crews cleared through property management or security before after-hours work, and we handle that coordination directly with your team. We can schedule around loading dock hours, security sign-in procedures, or elevator booking systems, whatever your building requires, and we confirm the access plan before install day.

faq.q: Will an indoor lobby tree meet fire and building code requirements?
faq.a: We use commercial-grade LED lighting on CSA or UL-rated cords with timers, which is what most property managers and fire inspectors expect for an indoor installation. We are happy to provide product specifications to your building's fire safety consultant or property manager ahead of time if your tower requires sign-off.

faq.q: We manage several buildings across the region. Can one contract cover all of them?
faq.a: Yes, this is one of the most common requests we get from facilities managers. We can quote a single program covering every property in your portfolio, from London to the western GTA, with one point of contact, one install schedule, and one invoice instead of separate vendors per building or per property manager.

faq.q: How far in advance should we book for a corporate lobby?
faq.a: Booking opens in late summer and our installation calendar for South-Western Ontario and the GTA fills by mid-November, so corporate accounts should reach out as early as possible. Installs run from early October through the first week of December, and lights can go up unlit and be turned on whenever your office wants to kick off the season.
